Description: The device shall measure systolic and diastolic pressure and pulse with an upper-arm cuff.
Mean error shall be within ±5 mmHg with a standard deviation of 8 mmHg or less.
A reading shall finish within 40 seconds.
The device shall never apply harmful pressure.
The cuff shall vent within 3 s when pressure reaches 300 mmHg.
A reading running past 180 s shall stop and vent.
Readings shall be sent to the phone app over Bluetooth LE.
The device shall keep 60 readings for each of 2 users without power.
The box and the device shall show the approval number, lot and expiry.
